description:
Mindfulness Music | Indian Classical | 1.5 Hours

A gentle, present space — whether you're starting the day or just need to land back in the moment. Ninety minutes of warm Indian classical music to slow your breath, settle your mind, and simply be here.

What you'll hear: an expressive bowed dilruba with a warm, voice-like tone over a soft pulse — bright and open, the feeling of a calm, clear mind in the present moment.

Best for: mindfulness or breathing practice · a slow morning · journaling · easing back into the present when the day gets loud.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to stay present, calm, and clear.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold patterned border. Bright, calm morning-to-daylight palette — warm soft golden light, serene and present (works for morning OR any calm moment, not strictly dawn). Central figure: a serene, centered musician playing a dilruba (bowed upright Indian classical string — show the bow), composed and gently present, soft light around them. IMPORTANT: vary the interior composition from the channel's other morning/calm thumbnails so it is visually distinct in-feed. Overlay text 'BE PRESENT' in dark-teal serif, large and mobile-readable. Mindfulness-neutral offering (works for the morning AND the generic title; calm lane = offering, NOT a Q-hook). The Indian-miniature style = cultural authority that intrigues T1 wellness viewers. Mobile-first: minimal clutter.
